protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: CVE.org records CVE-2026-40176 as PUBLISHED and the live GHSA is not withdrawn. At 2.9.5, root repository config supplies Perforce port/url and p4user while depot contributes to the generated client name; generateP4Command concatenates all three unescaped into one shell command passed to ProcessExecutor::execute. PerforceDriver::initialize invokes p4Login/checkStream/connectClient, so a malicious root composer.json can reach execution even when p4 itself is absent.

Later 64bda65e116d19cd97e8ddf2449d14b01ed727b8 only modifies the already-vulnerable helper.

That parent has no generateP4Command and no -u/-c/-p interpolation of getUser/getClient/getPort; its separate raw client-spec/sync strings are not this advisory's connection-parameter mechanism.
